# Firstword: Growth Ops, GTM Strategy & AI Automation for B2B Teams and SMBs

> Firstword helps B2B SaaS founders and SMBs build predictable pipeline and efficient operations through GTM consultancy & website positioning (including founder-led LinkedIn outbound), product consultancy, and custom business process & AI automations.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [GTM Consultancy & Outbound](https://first-word.netlify.app/gtm-consultancy): Go-To-Market roadmap, website positioning & conversion copywriting, ICP targeting, and done-for-you founder-led LinkedIn outbound execution that puts qualified demos on the calendar.
- [Product Consultancy](https://first-word.netlify.app/product-consultancy): Product strategy, onboarding optimization, and feature prioritization grounded in direct buyer feedback.
- [Business & AI Automations](https://first-word.netlify.app/automation): Custom workflow automation for SMBs and B2B teams — invoice automation, instant lead generation intake & WhatsApp routing, operations workflows, CRM data sync, and AI prospect intelligence briefs (e.g. 60-second AI briefs with buyer triggers, suggested replies, and demo prep). Covers Real Estate, Customs Brokerage, Insurance, Legal Firms, and Tech teams.

## Proof & Case Studies

- [Case Studies Overview](https://first-word.netlify.app/case-studies): Real outcomes for early-stage B2B SaaS companies and growing teams.
- [mple.ai Case Study](https://first-word.netlify.app/case-study-mpleai): How Firstword helped mple.ai validate positioning, automate AI reply intelligence, and book 100+ qualified enterprise demos.
